training_sampling: Uniform whole training prompt/response records with replacement; identical per-seed order for teacher and GRU
ngram_fit: Response positions only, using full available prompt as context; orders 1,4,8,16 with backoff to observed shorter contexts
bootstrap_unit: Paired model seeds and held-out composition groups; resample the same case clusters for teacher and every baseline, compare against strongest baseline in each draw
student_teacher_assignment: Teacher seed equals student seed; no teacher selection based on test or validation score
student_initialization: Fresh parameters on unchanged G2 rate architecture, no G1/G2 weight reuse
student_evaluation: After all 15 student runs finish, score all six categories of the disjoint final test: response CE, exact generation, teacher KL, zero-edge ablation
scope: Execution details fixed before any G2b training; original qualification thresholds unchanged
